detail.title: Accountable Cross-Turn State Continuity and AI Identity
detail.summary: State continuity across autonomous agent trajectories is critical to preventing high-stakes decision-making errors. Evidence suggests that without verifiable state (including hypotheses and evidence pointers), agents cannot effectively navigate complex risk scenarios.
detail.reason: Updating continuity requirements based on new risk analysis evidence.

children.title: Cycle 32 · Synthesizing High-Stakes Failure Modes and Agent Continuity

detail.title: Synthesizing High-Stakes Failure Modes and Agent Continuity
detail.summary: This cycle incorporates new evidence on autonomous decision-making risks (CBRN domain) into existing projects. Findings indicate that catastrophic failure in high-stakes environments often stems from agent trade-offs between helpfulness, harmlessness, and honesty, necessitating more robust self-correction and cross-turn state continuity. Notebooks for all three projects have been revised to reflect these insights.
